hero.headline: IntellySafe Edge System
hero.description: AI robotic system for active surveillance and autonomous monitoring.

panoramica.text1: IntellySafe Edge System is an AI robotic system for active surveillance, consisting of a distributed server application and a web application that can interface with robot navigation systems.
panoramica.text2: The system is capable of detecting intrusions, thanks to the cameras on board the robot and an optimized artificial intelligence algorithm able to recognize people or animals.
panoramica.text3: The system is controlled through a graphical interface accessible from a standard PC or tablet browser via wireless connection. The interface allows viewing of the onboard camera video and robot telemetry, creating and managing maps, scheduling and managing missions, as well as driving and controlling the robot via keyboard, mouse or joypad.

features.descrizione: Performs automatic actions when detecting malfunctions and intrusions
Sends alarm messages to field operators and the surveillance center
Can be operated via dedicated application both locally and remotely, ensuring maximum operator safety
Provides a programmable or automatic control service
Intercepts and documents activities carried out by unauthorized personnel in the surveilled area
Works collaboratively with other robots of the same series

kitMoliris.label: Autonomous navigation
kitMoliris.headline: Kit Moliris
kitMoliris.text: Installing the KIT on a mobile robot enables autonomous navigation through environment perception, area map building, robot localization on the map and obstacle avoidance.
kitMoliris.missionText1: The robot will autonomously reach a series of pre-selected stops called 'waypoints' on the map, activating sensors and actuators installed on board.
kitMoliris.missionText2: At each waypoint the robot can perform actions using sensors and actuators installed on board through a simple and intuitive interface.
